passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: MOTHER!? *sob* Mother... what did they *sob* do to you!? *sob*
[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Wilfred: *sob* I couldn't *sob* even say goodbye! *sob*

[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: The necklace... it's mother alright. *sob* I'm just glad Wini wasn't here to see it, she wouldn't have the heart for it.
[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Wilfred: It's inhumane. Not only to mother. We've lost some other neighbours too Meone... Good friends.

[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Wilfred: We even nearly lost Wini... and if we aren't quick enough we might... *sob*

[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Wilfred: *sob* That's right! I'm here to stop that from happening. I'll save Wini!

[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Wilfred: Ah! Uh yeah! You too Meone! You're saving her too!

[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text: Wilfred: Let's finish up in here quick. Looking at mother's body won't do any of us good.
